narrative.overview: The portfolio is an instrument, not a marketing page. A graphite field holds a calibrated system: an 88px construction grid, thin engineering linework, node constellations, and a volumetric core that only glows when it has something to say. The atmosphere is distinct without being loud — every dot, bracket, and orbital line earns its place by proving how Vo Huy thinks: whole-system, measured, and deliberately constrained. Make complexity feel intentional, not complicated. Make technology feel sophisticated, not flashy.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite carries the system; Signal Blue reveals the system
88px instrument grid is datum for all construction geometry
Flat and quiet at rest. Spatial and alive in motion
Mono as calibrated instrument, Sans as confident human voice
Zero-stock-imagery — all visuals are generative code

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears on ≤10% of any viewport at rest. If you can remove the blue and still understand the section, remove it.

rules.name: The Graphite Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from tonal steps Base → Panel → Raised and hair→edge border strength, not from shadow.

rules.name: The 10% Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono is only for labels ≤28 characters. Never set a sentence or lede in meta-label.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Body never exceeds 75ch; narrative sections cap at 52-65ch. Wider is not more readable — it's drift.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Glow, brightness, or elevated tone appears only as response to hover, focus, active, or scroll-driven state.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Only one Signal Blue glow source per viewport at rest. If two would glow, demote one to viz-s2.

dos: Do let Graphite carry depth and Signal Blue signal action — ≤10% blue per viewport.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; reveal depth only on hover/focus/scroll (glow, tonal step, border-edge).
Do use the 88px grid for construction alignment; every viz measurement derives from it.
Do keep body ≤75ch and narrative ≤52-65ch; wider is not more credible.
Do gate all motion and cursor illusions behind prefers-reduced-motion and pointer:fine.
Do keep mono labels ≤28 chars, uppercase, 0.18em tracking.
Do theme browser surfaces — ::selection accent/on-accent, scrollbar edge thumb, focus ring 2px accent.
Do use gap for sibling rhythm and border-hair for quiet division between items.
donts: Don't add gradient text, glass/blur decoration, thick left accent borders (>1px), or hard 4px 4px offset shadows.
Don't introduce large rounding (rounded-xl/2xl), sparklines/progress rings, or soft-shadowed rounded cards as structure.
Don't use mono as costume for running copy — reserved for labels, code, coordinates, and system states.
Don't split Signal Blue into multiple hues per screen or pair amber+mint+iris decoratively — one contextual signal at a time.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow above a headline — heading carries its own weight.
Don't deposit 3D/glow as wallpaper — one glow source per viewport at rest; field height capped 340→540 / 52vh.
Don't invent testimonials, metrics, or project imagery — all visuals are generative; all claims trace to app/data/*.
